title: Grilled Peach & Burrata Salad
description: Sweet grilled peaches with creamy burrata and fresh basil over arugula
ingredients: 3 peaches halved and pitted|8 oz burrata cheese|4 cups arugula|2 tbsp olive oil|1 tbsp balsamic glaze|1/4 cup fresh basil leaves|salt and pepper to taste
instructions: Brush peach halves with olive oil. Grill cut-side down over medium-high heat for 3-4 minutes until grill marks appear. Arrange arugula on a platter. Top with grilled peaches and torn burrata. Drizzle with balsamic glaze and olive oil. Scatter basil leaves. Season and serve immediately.

title: Smoky Chipotle Chicken Skewers
description: Tender chicken thighs marinated in smoky chipotle sauce grilled on skewers
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless chicken thighs cut into chunks|3 chipotle peppers in adobo sauce|3 cloves garlic|2 tbsp lime juice|2 tbsp olive oil|1 tsp cumin|1 tsp smoked paprika|salt to taste|1 red onion cut into chunks|2 bell peppers cut into chunks
instructions: Blend chipotles, garlic, lime juice, oil, cumin, paprika and salt into a marinade. Toss chicken in marinade and refrigerate 30 minutes. Thread chicken, onion and peppers onto skewers. Grill medium-high 5-6 minutes per side until cooked through. Serve with lime wedges.

title: Grilled Corn & Black Bean Bowl
description: Charred grilled corn with black beans avocado and cilantro lime rice
ingredients: 4 ears corn husked|1 can black beans drained and rinsed|2 avocados diced|1 cup cherry tomatoes halved|1/2 red onion diced|1/4 cup fresh cilantro|2 tbsp lime juice|2 cups cooked rice|1 tsp olive oil|salt and pepper
instructions: Grill corn over high heat 10-12 minutes turning until charred. Cut kernels off cob. Mix rice with half the lime juice and cilantro. Combine corn, beans, tomatoes and onion with remaining lime juice, oil, salt and pepper. Serve over rice topped with avocado and cilantro.
